verdict: Aggregation-cued event serving: 3 of 5 preregistered gates pass; the primary is a direction-consistent underpowered null and the run is recorded per the ship rule as an honest negative with a measured cause. Gate 1 (rag control vs ev2-sep-0804): exact zero over all 500 shared questions, contexts AND responses byte-identical. Gates 2-3 (claims-inertness -0.006 with 5 flips, reconstruction -0.004 with 4 flips) miss their exact-zero bars via the same extraction-stream noise floor the BEAM run measured the same morning (beam-ev-verdict.json): this run answers/judges 12 calls per question vs ev2's 8, perturbing the llama-server request stream around subsequent extraction calls; 29/500 rows show bank drift and all 9 flips sit on drift rows. Critically, the reconstruction check is structurally EXACT despite its letter failure: zero rows exist where the hybrid_ev context differs while the vanilla hybrid context is identical (0 prefix-property violations over 500 rows), so the variant deltas are not confounded by the serving-gate change - they share one bank within-run. Gate 4 (primary, hybrid_ev_syn vs hybrid_ev on multi-session n=133): +0.038, p 0.123, 6W/1L - direction consistent, underpowered at 7 discordant pairs. Decomposition: serving does the work (+0.030, 4W/0L), the tally line adds little (+0.007, 2W/1L). Gate 5 non-inferiority passes both halves: temporal-reasoning +0.007 and the four strong types EXACTLY zero (0/0 flips) - serving up to 30 events on aggregation cues is measurably harmless where it does not help, bounding the design's stated dilution risk at zero. The decision-relevant discovery is in the residual: of 24 multi-session rows where rag is right and syn still wrong, the events block is ABSENT on 16 - and widened serving reached only 44/133 ms rows against the design's predicted ~95. The remaining multi-session gap is two-thirds extraction-coverage-side, one-third answerer-side: the events pass misses instances (it has never been coverage-audited against a gold instance list, the design's first stated risk). Next experiment: events-pass coverage audit, then a re-run under a noise-floor-bounded validity gate (the exact-zero cross-run bar is unachievable at this call volume - measured twice today).

run.command: python evals/longmemeval_bench.py --dataset oracle --extractor qwen-27b --types all --chronicle --ev-variants --tag aggserve-0806 (preceded by an 8-question multi-session smoke, tag aggserve-smoke-0806, validated SMOKE OK rows=8 agg_widened=2 tally_rows=3 before the full run launched)
run.design: hybrid_ev reconstructs the ev2 old gate exactly (events iff temporal cue, first 6); hybrid_ev_agg serves the full returned list on either cue (service cap 30 on aggregation cues); hybrid_ev_syn adds a computed 'Total events listed: N' line. All three render from the same pinned search call that feeds the rag control.
run.judge: reproducible stock q8_0 llama-server via Start-Qwen (never -Fast)

gates.name: rag control (validity)
gates.prereg: rag vs ev2-sep-0804 rag, 500 shared questions, exactly 0 flips
gates.result: PASS (exact; contexts and responses byte-identical on all 500)

gates.name: claims-inertness (validity)
gates.prereg: vanilla hybrid vs ev2 hybrid, exactly 0 flips
gates.result: FAIL (bounded at the measured noise floor)
gates.forensics: 29/500 rows show hybrid-context drift (bank rebuilt differently); all 5 flips are on drift rows; rag contexts and responses are byte-identical on all 500, isolating the drift to extraction-time stream composition (12 answer/judge calls per question here vs 8 in ev2). Same mechanism, same day, as beam-ev-verdict.json gate 2; lesson recorded as memory signal 426 - future preregistrations bound this gate by the rag-control noise floor instead of demanding exact zero.

gates.name: reconstruction check (validity)
gates.prereg: this run's hybrid_ev vs ev2 hybrid_ev, exactly 0 flips; nonzero would mean the old-gate reconstruction or the limit-6/limit-30 prefix property is wrong and every variant delta is confounded
gates.forensics: Zero prefix-property violations over 500 rows: every row whose hybrid_ev context differs from ev2 also differs in the vanilla hybrid context (29 rows, the same bank-drift set as gate 2), and all 4 flips are on those rows. The reconstruction logic and the first-6-of-30 prefix property are verified exact; the letter failure is inherited bank drift, not a serving-gate confound. Within-run variant deltas (gates 4-5) share one bank and are unconfounded.

gates.name: primary: hybrid_ev_syn vs hybrid_ev on multi-session (confirmatory status lost to gates 2-3; would also have missed p<0.05 on its own)
gates.prereg: improvement with p < 0.05, n=133, sign-flip permutation 10k/seed 0
gates.reading: The multi-session ladder is monotone: hybrid 0.376 -> hybrid_ev 0.398 -> hybrid_ev_agg 0.429 -> hybrid_ev_syn 0.436 vs rag 0.504; widened serving+tally recover ~36% of the rag gap. But widened serving reached only 44/133 ms rows against the design's predicted ~95, and of the 24 residual rows (rag right, syn wrong) the events block is absent on 16: the gap is two-thirds extraction-coverage-side, one-third answerer-side. union(rag, syn) = 0.617.

gates.name: non-inferiority: temporal-reasoning and the four strong types (margin 0.02 each)
gates.result: PASS (both; strong set exactly zero flips - the wider gate's dilution risk is bounded at zero)

decision: Not promoted to ship-candidate status (the prereg requires 5/5). The serving change stays in the tree as merged dead code behind chronicle default-off, unblessed by measurement; no docs claim gains a number from gates 2-4. Follow-ups in priority order: (1) events-pass coverage audit against a gold instance list on the multi-session slice - the residual decomposition (16 of 24 loss rows unserved; 44/133 widened vs ~95 predicted) makes coverage the measured bottleneck, ahead of any answerer-side work; (2) re-run the aggserve gates under a noise-floor-bounded validity bar (|delta| <= rag-control floor) once coverage improves - the exact-zero cross-run bar failed twice today for the same measured reason and is retired as a gate design (memory signal 426); (3) the tally line is cheap and harmless but not load-bearing (+0.007, p 1.0) - keep it only if it survives the coverage-fixed re-run.
